craft_notes: Sthāyin: alphabet-wonder. Close: naming. Rejected: 'lunar mansions' — killed: moon-days kept; avasāna (vs nakāra) kept.

lines: First now: all lunar days, vowels drop-ending all;
within, time-yoked, moon and sun are named.
l4.sanskrit_cite: athādyāstithayaḥ sarve svarā bindvavasānagāḥ | tadantaḥ kālayogena somasūryau prakīrtitau

reads_against.argmap: First: drop-ending vowels; moon-sun proclaimed inside by time's yoking.
